before.en: Install domestic TRAE CN Desktop and the CodexHost TRAE CN Bridge extension, then sign in inside Desktop.
before.zh-CN: 安装国内 TRAE CN 桌面应用和 CodexHost TRAE CN Bridge 扩展，并在桌面应用内登录。

after.en: Keep the target workspace open and trusted in TRAE CN. Build the Companion VSIX with npm run build:companion --workspace=@codexhost/adapter-trae-cn and use Install from VSIX in Desktop. Standalone Trae CLI authentication is not used. Restart CodexHost after changing its application path.
after.zh-CN: 在 TRAE CN 中打开并信任目标工作目录。运行 npm run build:companion --workspace=@codexhost/adapter-trae-cn 打包 Bridge，再在桌面应用内从 VSIX 安装；不使用独立 Trae CLI 的登录。修改应用路径后重启 CodexHost。

notice.en: Desktop integration in development. Native IPC verified on Windows TRAE CN 3.4.12; complete support and other versions remain under validation.
notice.zh-CN: 桌面接入开发中。原生 IPC 已在 Windows TRAE CN 3.4.12 验证；完整能力和其他版本仍待验收。
